description: This file defines the class printDocOptions, which manages various configuration options for document printing, including document format, requirement specifications, test specifications, and execution options within the TestLink project.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates options for printing documents, test specifications, requirement specifications, and execution details in the TestLink project.

methods.name: getDocOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of document format options.

methods.name: getTestSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of test specification options.

methods.name: getReqSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of requirement specification options.

methods.name: getExecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of execution options.

methods.name: getAllOptVars
methods.description: Returns an associative array of all options with their checked states converted to 0 or 1.

methods.name: getJSPrintPreferences
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of all option values for JavaScript preferences.
